Stock market news | Adani Energy Solutions wins 1,750 MW contract

Adani Energy Solutions received a contract to supply 1,750 MW of renewable power to West Bengal. Supply for the initial capacity will begin on 1 July 2028, with an optional 750 MW greenshoe starting 1 April 2029.
The win adds to AESL's growing footprint in India's power transmission segment after a major project in Bihar, strengthening its role in the country's renewable energy expansion.
